Thanks again for the time today. Per our call, attaching a short Mutual Action Plan (MAP) outline and proposed evaluation run plan so we can align on success criteria. High level asks:

- Redwood will run two sustained throughput profiles (burst QPS and sustained QPS) against your sample workload and the pinned model variant.

Ana — great, thanks. Looping in Marissa and Rishi for the run. Quick notes for the evaluation plan:

- Baseline model: open-model-1.3 (FP16) pinned. Quantized variant: open-model-1.3-8bit (Q4).
- Runs to execute:
  1) Latency profile: 1000 warmup requests then 5k steady single-user QPS ramp to capture TTFT and p50/p95/p99.
  2) Throughput profile: sustained concurrency sweeps at conc=8,16,32,64 measuring tokens/sec and sustained QPS over 30min windows.
  3) Stress run: 10m request burst to validate graceful degradation/fallback behavior.

Marissa — can you run the quantized vs FP16 pass on our Dedicated pool and drop a CSV of time-series tokens/sec and per-token cost calc? Also include GPU utilization traces.

Rishi — can you capture kernel selection logs and note any multimodel routing we should enable?

Karthik

Subject: Re: MAP kickoff: throughput evaluation approach and close timeline

Hi all — ran the planned passes on 5/14–5/16. Summary below; attaching ttft_results_q2.csv and throughput logs. Key takeaways:

- TTFT (endpoint measured at Redwood edge): FP16 median=95 ms; Q4 median=110 ms. 95th perc: FP16=320 ms; Q4=360 ms (note tail increase). From FinBank edge (APAP proxy) add ~18–25 ms network overhead.
- Throughput: sustained tokens/sec (30m window) at concurrency 64:
  - FP16: 128,400 tokens/sec (stable, GPU utilization ~87%)
  - Q4: 142,900 tokens/sec (stable after warmup, GPU utilization ~75%)
- Sustained QPS (user-facing single-turn flows): at conc 16 we saw ~28 sustained QPS for FP16, ~33 sustained QPS for Q4.
- Unit economics (back-of-envelope based on Dedicated pricing):
  - FP16: $14.2 per 1M tokens (includes infra amortized + ops)
  - Q4: $9.7 per 1M tokens (better token throughput due to 8-bit execution)
  - Break-even quantization amortization ~120k tokens/sec sustained for a typical FinBank ledger workload.

Risks/notes: Q4 shows slightly worse p95 latency; recommend a small-prefix KV cache for low-latency endpoints to get p95 back under 350 ms. Also saw a kernel fallback during the stress burst at minute 7 — Rishi, logs attached.

Marissa

Adding kernel/log detail: during the stress burst at 2026-05-15T12:07Z we observed a conditional kernel fallback on the attention path for long sequences (>1024 tokens) which introduced 40–80 ms extra latency for those requests. Mitigation: enable chunked attention execution for long sequences or cap request-size in the low-latency route and use batch route for long-form generation.

Also attached: perfbench run metadata and a line-level tokens/sec time series.

Rishi

  3) Security/compliance: FinBank to share SOC2 attestation copy and required audit scope (Owner: FinBank) — due 5/21.
  4) Go-live target: 6/15 for beta (soft launch); full production: 7/01.

Can we target signature by 5/24 per the MAP? If yes, Contracts please confirm the path and I'll book a quick sign-off call this week.

Thanks — excited to move forward.
